tasks.label: Wait for Backend API
tasks.command: for attempt in {1..60}; do if curl --silent --fail --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:8002/api/v1/ping_destinations >/dev/null; then echo 'Backend API is ready'; exit 0; fi; sleep 1; done; echo 'Backend API did not become ready within 60 seconds' >&2; exit 1
